final: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(w AS FLOAT)) AS avg_wins, AVG(CAST(g - l AS FLOAT) / CAST(l AS FLOAT)) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half WHERE w IS NOT NULL AND l IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND l != 0 GROUP BY team_id), mean_wins AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT ts.team_id, ts.avg_wins, ts.avg_ratio, ts.avg_wins - m.mean_avg_wins AS gap FROM team_stats ts CROSS JOIN mean_wins m WHERE ts.avg_wins > m.mean_avg_wins ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
